        b.push(m)
    assert b.fen() == row['fen'] and b.outcome(claim_draw=True) is None
    legal = {m.uci() for m in b.legal_moves}
    assert set(row['raw']) == set(row['target']) == set(row['candidate_scores']) == legal
    assert row['selected_action'] in legal
    for arm in ('raw', 'target'):
        assert abs(sum(row[arm].values()) - 1) < 1e-6
        assert all(math.isfinite(p) and p >= 0 for p in row[arm].values())
        expected = sum(p * row['candidate_scores'][m]['expected_score'] for m, p in row[arm].items())
        assert abs(expected - row['expected_score'][arm]) < 1e-12
    assert abs(row['effect'] - (row['expected_score']['target'] - row['expected_score']['raw'])) < 1e-12
    for m, s in row['candidate_scores'].items():
        assert s['forced'] == m and not s['lowerbound'] and not s['upperbound']
        assert abs(sum(s['wdl']) - 1) < 1e-12 and s['budget_nodes'] == 32768
        assert abs(s['expected_score'] - (s['wdl'][0] + .5*s['wdl'][1])) < 1e-12
    counts[(row['family'], b.turn)] += 1
assert len(counts) == 96 and set(counts.values()) == {1}
assert len(queries) == result['reference_queries'] == sum(len(r['raw']) for r in rows)
assert sum(q['nodes'] for q in queries) == result['reference_actual_nodes']
effects = [sum(r['effect'] for r in rows if r['family'] == f)/2 for f in range(48)]
assert effects == result['family_effects']
assert abs(sum(effects)/48 - result['mean_expected_score_effect']) < 1e-12
audit = {'status': 'pass', 'positions': 96, 'families': 48,
         'source_reconstruction_exact': True, 'queries': len(queries),
         'actual_nodes': result['reference_actual_nodes'],
         'observed_outcomes': dict(collections.Counter(str(r['observed_outcome']) for r in rows)),
         'unique_full_histories': len({(r['root_fen'], tuple(r['moves'])) for r in rows}),
         'positive_positions': sum(r['effect'] > 1e-12 for r in rows),
         'negative_positions': sum(r['effect'] < -1e-12 for r in rows),
         'hashes': {p.name: hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in root.iterdir() if p.is_file()}}
(root / 'integrity-audit.json').write_text(json.dumps(audit, indent=2)+'\n')
